segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I wanted to walk through the seat count and the implementation timing so I can get the quote cleaned up in the CRM today.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sure. We’re at 46 users for launch. That’s 38 standard seats and 8 manager seats. We may add another 10 in Q2, but I don’t want those on the first order.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it, 46 total for the initial term. The pricing sheet has the standard seats at $72 per user per month and manager seats at $118. With annual billing, that puts year one at $45,888 before the onboarding fee.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, and onboarding was $6,500, right? I need the invoice to split that out separately because finance codes services differently.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, $6,500 one-time onboarding, shown as a separate line item. Software subscription separate. I’ll also note that the invoice should go to ap@northlinecomponents.com with PO 41792.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. On timing, our target go-live is March 18. We can start implementation the week of February 12 if the contract is done by next Friday.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: That works. Our implementation lead confirmed a February 13 kickoff is available. It’s usually four to five weeks for your scope, especially since you’re only doing the billing tool integration and not the warehouse feed yet.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Right. Legal had one question on the renewal language. They want the auto-renewal notice window to be 60 days instead of 30.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: That’s within our standard fallback. I’ll send it to deal desk, but that should be fine. Initial term is 12 months, March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027, annual billing upfront.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yes. Send the updated order form and redline today if you can. If legal signs off, I can route for signature Monday.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. I’ll get the revised order form over by 3:00 Eastern, with the seat breakdown, the separate onboarding line, PO reference, and the 60-day renewal notice.
